verdict.rationale: Board consents and resolutions are a fair question for an incorporation and equity platform like Atlas. The pack only documents Cooley-built incorporation templates, a Documents tab for viewing incorporation documents, and SAFE creation and tracking. None of that shows Atlas preparing board consents or resolutions or collecting director approvals online; those features are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
